items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: And then of course Eva Taylor, I loved Eva Taylor’s singing.

ctx.x: Who was the next vocalist to effect you like Bessie Smith did?

Nobody ever really effected me like Bessie, but I was cognizant of other singers and one was Ethel Waters of course. I admired enormously Ethel Waters because she had great diction. If you’ll understand that I couldn’t understand what Ma Rainey was saying, and I had trouble with Bessie, I found that with Ethel Waters she had beautiful diction. And then of course Eva Taylor, I loved Eva Taylor’s singing. Because Eva had a great sort of clarity to her voice. So I was impressed by these singers. I didn’t turn on to…

Was there a language, not a barrier but some of the things that Bessie Smith may have sung, even if you understood what she was saying, that there was a new phrase in there that maybe wasn’t common to English.
